description: This file defines an Android activity class 'PersistentState' that demonstrates how to use SharedPreferences to persist and restore UI state (text input and selection) across activity restarts.

classes.name: PersistentState
classes.description: An Activity subclass that saves and restores the state of an EditText using SharedPreferences to demonstrate persistent UI state management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and references the UI elements.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores the saved text and selection state from SharedPreferences when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves the current text and selection state to SharedPreferences when the activity is paused.
